items.name: Backlog commentary, Q2 2026
items.claim: Novanta describes a healthy backlog alongside strong bookings and new product revenue contributions supporting confidence in delivering robust organic revenue growth.
items.source_excerpt: Strong bookings, a healthy backlog, new product revenue contributions and disciplined commercial execution in market segments benefiting from long-term secular growth trends, reinforce our confidence in delivering robust organic revenue growth

items.name: Humanoid-robotics design wins in Europe
items.claim: Novanta reports recent design wins in Europe for humanoid-robotics motion and sensing subsystems; initial volumes are limited but establish a foundation for long-term participation as production scales.
items.source_excerpt: Recent design wins in Europe reflect this approach. While initial volumes are limited, they establish a foundation for long-term participation as production scales.
